role: Neutral research and source validation only; no adjudication or reconstruction authorization

readiness.why: Affirmative personal statutory claim, Lindblom damages request, whole-complaint dismissal and continued Privacy Act appeal identify a substantial potential monetary route. Missing subsection labels or renewed prayer do not establish abandonment or require reconstruction.

material_distinctions.question: Personal statutory injury
material_distinctions.classification: Article III legal characterization plus procedural-stage factual support
material_distinctions.support: Identified retained records concerning claimant; personal chilling alleged in Petition 4 but not thereby proved; constitutional-standing analysis is claim-specific.

material_distinctions.question: Available money remedy
material_distinctions.classification: Actual remedy/cause/waiver legal inquiry; ultimate liability distinct
material_distinctions.support: 102 F.3d 602; Opposition 3 cites C.A. App.10 for Lindblom damages. Section (g)(1)(D)/(g)(4) potentially applies; no supported money abandonment.

material_distinctions.question: Adverse effect
material_distinctions.classification: Statutory requirement needing legal construction and relevant record support
material_distinctions.support: Albright permits emotional trauma as adverse effect but requires causation; reserves actual-damages/minimum issues. Havens does not decide the additional Privacy Act text.

material_distinctions.question: Amendment request/refusal/review
material_distinctions.classification: Potential route-specific predicate; unrecovered correspondence is a research gap
material_distinctions.support: Access exhaustion does not establish amendment exhaustion. Nagel/Clarkson/Doe supply competing and qualified remedial rules.

material_distinctions.question: Record-specific exemptions
material_distinctions.classification: Potential cause/consent/relief limitation requiring applicable statute/regulation and supported facts
material_distinctions.support: FOIA exemptions are not Privacy Act exemptions; (e)(7) is nonexemptible; Doe distinguishes lawful (d) exemption from improper avoidance of nonexemptible duties.

material_distinctions.question: Independent prospective equity
material_distinctions.classification: Legal cause/preclusion/waiver issue concerning existing action
material_distinctions.support: Actual Reich and section 702; no invented APA count or personal-name caption defect. Specific Privacy Act scheme supplies contrary displacement argument.

material_distinctions.question: Present pertinence, willfulness, amount, final decree
material_distinctions.classification: Generally contested merits or ultimate relief, not proof-of-success standing prerequisites
material_distinctions.support: Current pertinence disputed in Petition 7 and Opposition 9 n.6; district order does not decide it expressly.

Use a confined threshold corrective disposition only for a genuine unresolved judicial question, not researcher document nonpossession.
After establishing jurisdiction and cause, reserve record-specific relief and liability questions for ordinary further proceedings.
remaining_source_limits: Full complaint, original administrative correspondence, complete declarations/district motion papers and full Court of Appeals appendix not recovered.
District order incorporates Government reasons; absent incorporated briefs preclude certifying all possible district grounds.
No located express amendment/refusal/review, record-specific Privacy Act exemption determination, statutory adverse-effect finding, or money abandonment.
These coverage limits are not findings of litigation deficiency, waiver or lack of injury.
